title: Data
subtitle: Every data source the agent can use: is it working, who can use it, and what it means.
infoBody: One list for websites kept as tables, Aquarium's own data and databases you connect. A dictionary explains each table in plain words: what one row is, what the columns mean, how tables join and how metrics are counted. Agents only use approved versions. Anyone with access can suggest changes; the source's owner or an admin approves them.

access.always: Owners and admins always have access.

note.app: Members only ever see their own rows; sharing shows them the dictionary, not other people's rows.
note.site: This list is who can ask about it in chat and see its dictionary. Who can open the rows in Sites is set separately:
note.connection: People you share with ask through this connection's read-only login and never see the password.

access.readOnly: Only the owner or an admin can change who has access.

list.emptyBody: Sites you add, databases you connect and data shared with you appear here.
list.footSites: Websites are added and refreshed in
list.footVpn: VPNs databases go through are in

detail.answersUse: Answers use this version · approved by {who}, {when}
detail.noneApproved: Nothing approved yet: agents answer from the table structure and say so.
detail.emptyBody: Use Build dictionary to have the agent study the tables and draft descriptions for you to approve.
detail.emptyBodyRead: The owner hasn't described these tables yet.
detail.driftTitle: The schema changed — {n} tables no longer match this dictionary
detail.driftTitleOne: The schema changed — 1 table no longer matches this dictionary
detail.driftHint: Answers may use outdated meanings until the owner updates them.

build.label: Build dictionary
build.hint: Opens a chat with the request filled in. Nothing starts until you press send.
build.prompt: Study the {source} data source and draft dictionary entries for the tables that aren't described yet. Ask me about anything unclear before proposing.
build.title: Build dictionary — {name}
build.onDemandHint: Any other table is studied the first time someone asks about it.
build.bigNote: There is no “all tables” study for a big source: the agent studies the picked schemas in batches and adds them to the draft as it goes.

scopePrompt.schemas: Study the {source} data source, schemas {schemas} only, and draft dictionary entries for their tables that aren't described yet. Ask me about anything unclear before proposing.
scopePrompt.changed: The {source} schema changed. Re-study these tables and draft updated dictionary entries: {tables}. Ask me about anything unclear before proposing.

build.onDemandPrompt: Leave the other tables for now; study one the first time someone asks about it.

edit.title: Edit {table}
edit.hint: Your change goes into the draft. Answers keep using the approved version until the owner approves it.
edit.columnsHint: One column per line: name: what it means

history.title: History
history.restoreBody: Its text becomes the approved version again, saved as a new version. Nothing is lost: the current version stays in history.
history.restoreBlocked: Approve or discard the open draft before restoring an older version.

review.title: Review draft
review.noneBody: Suggested changes from chats, edits and studies collect here.
review.hint: Accept or reject each change, then approve. Rejected tables keep their approved text.
review.hintRead: Only the owner or an admin can approve. You can see what's waiting.
review.discardBody: All suggested changes in it are dropped. The approved version stays as it is.

share.title: Share dictionary
share.always: The owner and admins always have access. Sharing a dictionary doesn't show anyone rows they can't already see.
share.removeBody: They lose access to this dictionary straight away.
share.levels: Can read: see the approved dictionary. Can propose changes: also suggest edits for the owner to approve.
share.directoryError: Couldn't load the list of people, so you can't add anyone right now. Try again later; existing access is unchanged.

answer.noDictionary: Based on {source} · no approved dictionary yet
answer.saved: Saved as a suggested example. The owner will review it.
answer.correctHint: Tell the agent what's wrong in your next message. It will fix the answer and suggest a dictionary change for the owner to approve.
answer.undescribed: {tables} isn't described yet, so this answer is based only on column names. Ask the agent to describe it, and the owner approves the description under Data.

overview.brokenBody: Answers about this data source fail until it's fixed.

healthHint.app: Aquarium's own data is always available.
healthHint.site: From the site's last refresh run.
healthHint.connection: Checked every hour; the check also keeps the connection open.

source.about: Aquarium's own database. Agents never query the real tables: for each question they read a private copy of only the rows the asker may see.
source.siteBody: Design, refresh runs and schedule stay in Sites; dictionary, access and questions are here.
source.connectionBody: Server, login, VPN and tests are under Add data source.
source.connectionOwnerOnly: Only {who} can see the connection settings.

add.title: Add data source
add.subtitle: Pick what to add. You can test it before anyone else can use it.
add.mssqlBody: Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2 and newer. Ask IT for a read-only login.
add.sqliteBody: A .sqlite or .db file in Files, read-only.
add.siteBody: The agent studies the site, proposes tables for you to approve, then keeps them up to date. Continues in Sites › Add site.
add.siteLockedBody: Your role can't add sites. Ask the owner or an admin.
add.sheetBody: Google Sheets or Excel in Files.
add.apiBody: A REST API the agent can read.
add.privateNote: A data source you add is private to you until you share it. Owners and admins can always see it.

ask.label: Ask about:
ask.autoHint: It picks from the data sources you can use and asks if unsure.
ask.title: Ask about

description.mysql: Your own MySQL / MariaDB connections. Private to you until you share the data source; people you share with ask through this read-only login and never see the password.
description.sqlite: SQLite files on this server, read-only. Only files under the folders set in config.yaml (data_sources.sqlite_roots) can be added.

db.driverMissing: The driver for this engine isn't installed on the server yet.
db.sqliteAdminOnly: Only the owner or an admin can add SQLite files.
db.errName: Use letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores (up to 64).
db.errPort: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
db.name: Name
db.label: Display name (optional)
db.passwordKept: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
db.readOnlyNote: Use a read-only login: the agent only reads from this database.
db.removeBody: The agent stops using it, and its data source and dictionary are removed from Data.
